def enforce_binary(h):
    # Enforce binary constraints with graph cuts
    h_binary = np.zeros(len(h))
    n_zero = int(len(h)-np.sum(h))
    # Sort indices by density
    indices = np.argsort(h)
    h_binary[indices[:n_zero]] = 0.0
    h_binary[indices[n_zero:]] = 1.0
    return h_binary, np.sum(h_binary)
